name: hakoniwa
description: Hakoniwa desktop workbench for supervising AI development tasks.

scripts.dev: npm run build:dev-shell && concurrently -k "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:main:watch" "npm run dev:preload:watch" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 release/mac-arm64/Hakoniwa.app/Contents/MacOS/Hakoniwa && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 release/mac-arm64/Hakoniwa.app/Contents/MacOS/Hakoniwa"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:main:watch" "npm run dev:preload:watch" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist/main/main.js dist/preload/preload.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:dev-shell: tsc && npm run build:preload && vite build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:preload && vite build && electron-builder --dir
